name: Myonion
description: myOnion.fun is a groundbreaking platform built on the Alephium blockchain, inspired by the popular pump.fun. It offers users the ability to create their own meme tokens, trade them instantly, and graduate them to a fully integrated mini-DEX within the platform for long-term trading and growth. With its user-friendly interface and playful community, myOnion.fun redefines meme token creation and trading by combining creativity, accessibility, and its very own decentralized exchange.
